entries.title: Isaiah 30:1
segments: ¶"Woe to the rebellious children," says the LORD, "Who take counsel, but not of Me, And who devise plans, but not of My Spirit, That they may add sin to sin;

entries.title: Isaiah 30:2
segments: Who walk to go down to Egypt, And have not asked My advice, To strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, And to trust in the shadow of Egypt!

entries.title: Isaiah 30:3
segments: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh Shall be your shame, And trust in the shadow of Egypt Shall be [your] humiliation.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:4
segments: For his princes were at Zoan, And his ambassadors came to Hanes.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:5
segments: They were all ashamed of a people [who] could not benefit them, Or be help or benefit, But a shame and also a reproach."

entries.title: Isaiah 30:6
segments: The burden against the beasts of the South. Through a land of trouble and anguish, From which [came] the lioness and lion, The viper and fiery flying serpent, They will carry their riches on the backs of young donkeys, And their treasures on the humps of camels, To a people [who] shall not profit;

entries.title: Isaiah 30:7
segments: For the Egyptians shall help in vain and to no purpose. Therefore I have called her Rahab-Hem-Shebeth.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:8
segments: ¶Now go, write it before them on a tablet, And note it on a scroll, That it may be for time to come, Forever and ever:

entries.title: Isaiah 30:9
segments: That this [is] a rebellious people, Lying children, Children [who] will not hear the law of the LORD;

entries.title: Isaiah 30:10
segments: Who say to the seers, "Do not see," And to the prophets, "Do not prophesy to us right things; Speak to us smooth things, prophesy deceits.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:11
segments: Get out of the way, Turn aside from the path, Cause the Holy One of Israel To cease from before us."

entries.title: Isaiah 30:12
segments: Therefore thus says the Holy One of Israel: "Because you despise this word, And trust in oppression and perversity, And rely on them,

entries.title: Isaiah 30:13
segments: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you Like a breach ready to fall, A bulge in a high wall, Whose breaking comes suddenly, in an instant.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:14
segments: And He shall break it like the breaking of the potter's vessel, Which is broken in pieces; He shall not spare. So there shall not be found among its fragments A shard to take fire from the hearth, Or to take water from the cistern."

entries.title: Isaiah 30:15
segments: For thus says the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel: "In returning and rest you shall be saved; In quietness and confidence shall be your strength." But you would not,

entries.title: Isaiah 30:16
segments: And you said, "No, for we will flee on horses" -Therefore you shall flee! And, "We will ride on swift [horses]" -Therefore those who pursue you shall be swift!

entries.title: Isaiah 30:17
segments: One thousand [shall flee] at the threat of one, At the threat of five you shall flee, Till you are left as a pole on top of a mountain And as a banner on a hill.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:18
segments: ¶Therefore the LORD will wait, that He may be gracious to you; And therefore He will be exalted, that He may have mercy on you. For the LORD [is] a God of justice; Blessed [are] all those who wait for Him.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:19
segments: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem; You shall weep no more. He will be very gracious to you at the sound of your cry; When He hears it, He will answer you.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:20
segments: And [though] the Lord gives you The bread of adversity and the water of affliction, Yet your teachers will not be moved into a corner anymore, But your eyes shall see your teachers.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:21
segments: Your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying, "This [is] the way, walk in it," Whenever you turn to the right hand Or whenever you turn to the left.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:22
segments: You will also defile the covering of your graven images of silver, And the ornament of your molded images of gold. You will throw them away as an unclean thing; You will say to them, "Get away!"

entries.title: Isaiah 30:23
segments: Then He will give the rain for your seed With which you sow the ground, And bread of the increase of the earth; It will be fat and plentiful. In that day your cattle will feed In large pastures.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:24
segments: Likewise the oxen and the young donkeys that work the ground Will eat cured fodder, Which has been winnowed with the shovel and fan.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:25
segments: There will be on every high mountain And on every high hill Rivers [and] streams of waters, In the day of the great slaughter, When the towers fall.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:26
segments: Moreover the light of the moon will be as the light of the sun, And the light of the sun will be sevenfold, As the light of seven days, In the day that the LORD binds up the bruise of His people And heals the stroke of their wound.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:27
segments: ¶Behold, the name of the LORD comes from afar, Burning [with] His anger, And [His] burden [is] heavy; His lips are full of indignation, And His tongue like a devouring fire.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:28
segments: His breath is like an overflowing stream, Which reaches up to the neck, To sift the nations with the sieve of futility; And [there shall be] a bridle in the jaws of the people, Causing [them] to err.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:29
segments: You shall have a song As in the night [when] a holy festival is kept, And gladness of heart as when one goes with a flute, To come into the mountain of the LORD, To the Mighty One of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:30
segments: The LORD will cause His glorious voice to be heard, And show the descent of His arm, With the indignation of [His] anger And the flame of a devouring fire, [With] scattering, tempest, and hailstones.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:31
segments: For through the voice of the LORD Assyria will be beaten down, [As] He strikes with the rod.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:32
segments: And [in] every place where the staff of punishment passes, Which the LORD lays on him, [It] will be with tambourines and harps; And in battles of brandishing He will fight with it.

entries.title: Isaiah 30:33
segments: For Tophet [was] established of old, Yes, for the king it is prepared. He has made [it] deep and large; Its pyre [is] fire with much wood; The breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, Kindles it.
